post.description:
Pull and run the aws-installer container synchronously.
Blocks until the container exits — the installer writes the thing name
to the DB via POST /controller-config/aws-status before exiting.
Returns the controller config (with thing_name populated) on success.

`force=true` re-runs the installer on an already-installed controller. The
installer is idempotent (provisioning is skipped when it's already done) but
always rewrites the Mosquitto bridge config and restarts the broker, so this
is the supported repair for a controller that provisioned but never bridged
to AWS — otherwise the only fix is SSH.

Called by the aws-installer container to write the thing name and
final install status to the database.
